# Zahid Inn

> A 20-room boutique courtyard hotel at 9-13 Asaka 2nd Lane, Tashkent, Uzbekistan.
> Two low buildings around a pair of shaded courtyards, near the old city centre.
> Front desk open 24 hours. The site is published in English and Russian.

Booking is handled off-site by OtelMS: https://booking-115047.otelms.com

## Contact

- Address: 9-13 Asaka 2nd Lane, Tashkent, Uzbekistan (RU: Ташкент, 2-й переулок Асака, 9-13)
- Phone: +998 95 511 11 12
- Email: zahidinn.2@gmail.com
- Telegram: https://t.me/zahid-inn_hotel
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/zahid.inn
- Front desk: open 24 hours, every day

## Rooms and nightly rates

Rates are in Uzbekistani soum (UZS) per night. Tourist tax is not included: it is
paid separately at 10% of the base calculation value (BCV) per person per night,
and does not apply to children under 16.

- Single Room — 450,000 UZS
- Budget Twin Room — 550,000 UZS
- Double Room — 650,000 UZS
- Comfort Double Room — 750,000 UZS
- Comfort Triple Room — 850,000 UZS
- Two-Room Suite — 1,250,000 UZS

## Amenities

Breakfast, luggage storage, free Wi-Fi throughout, free parking, BBQ area,
laundry, 24/7 guest kitchen, garden courtyard.

## Guest ratings

- Booking.com: 9.6 / 10 (Traveller Review Awards 2026)
- Ostrovok: 9.4 / 10 (Guests' Choice 2025)
- Yandex Travel: 5.0 / 5 (452 reviews)
- Tripadvisor: 4.9 / 5
